name: Browser Use Web UI
description: Gradio interface for running browser-use agents from a web page, with a choice of LLM provider and your own browser.
whatItDoes: Gives non-programmers a form-based way to start a browser agent, watch it work and keep the session open between tasks. It can attach to the user's existing browser so logged-in sessions are reused.
howItWorks: A local Python server renders a Gradio app that configures and launches the browser-use agent loop. Settings come from an env file and the UI, and the browser is driven through Playwright. A Docker setup is also provided.

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Set in .env for the chosen provider

models: Google, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Ollama
